goals.text: Open Faith and join or create a prayer challenge.

giveUp: Gave up. The screen did not change after 3 actions.
deadEnds: the screen did not change after 3 actions
device: GRIIT iPhone 16. Persona phone size was recorded and not applied, because this is the simulator that has the app installed.

interview.openTomorrow: Yes, absolutely. I want to complete all 7 days of this morning prayer challenge. Starting my day with intention and prayer is exactly what I need, and this app makes it easy to track.
interview.secured: I think it means my progress is saved and protected - like my streaks and completion data won't be lost if I close the app or restart my phone.
interview.freeze: Maybe it's a way to pause my challenge temporarily without losing my streak? Like if I'm sick or traveling and can't do it for a few days, I can freeze instead of breaking my chain.
interview.selfReported: This probably means the app trusts me to honestly report whether I actually completed my prayer or intention, rather than verifying it somehow. It's based on my own integrity.
interview.best: Seeing the timer count down and knowing I'm dedicating these 5 minutes to prayer and setting my intention for the day. It feels powerful to have it tracked and to be on Day 1 of 7.
interview.worst: That the timer shows I've already used 8 minutes and 57 seconds when I just started. I wanted a full 5-minute session, so I might need to reset and start over.
interview.tellFriend: Yes, definitely. I'd tell them: 'This app helped me commit to morning prayer in a structured way. It's simple, it keeps you accountable with a 7-day challenge, and it continues running even if you leave, so you won't accidentally stop it. Perfect for anyone wanting to build a daily prayer habit.'
